name: Niekus
backstory: Child of Nakus and Niemus; raised in Salthos Cruzados on walks the transit route's Salthos stretch at dawn..., and carries some knowledge of Birth Of Nierius.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnukas.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Darius, named Darnus.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Fenserika and Darius now have a child, Darika.
Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dornakus.
Heard that Prince Doran and Nakus now have a child, Nakoran.
Heard that Nakus and Prince Doran now have a child, Dorukus.
Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darnarika.
Heard that Nieragus and Dorakus now have a child, Nieradus.
Had a child with Fenserika, named Fenekus.
Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darinak.
Heard that Darnakus and Niemoran now have a child, Niemornak.
Had a child with Nieragan, named Nierakus.
Heard that Dornakus and Doraknus now have a child, Dornaknis.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Forliamus Log Crossing War their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Forliamus Log Crossing War as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: picks up his father's watch along the Salthos stretch at dawn, waves familiar faces through without a second look, and is starting to spot the ones worth a second look

arc.premise: Niekus has stopped keeping a private tally against the house's own count, and started building an actual lockbox and ledger stand at his post - a fixed place every toll gets recorded the moment it's paid, so there's nothing left to reconstruct after the fact.
